card.fact_statement: Christian Lindner made a public statement regarding the 2025 German federal election.
card.source_span: The FDP party leader Christian Lindner accused the new government of "unrestrained debt creation".

target_qa_variants.source_span: The FDP party leader Christian Lindner accused the new government of "unrestrained debt creation".
